description:
• Leads and performs application development, configuration and unit testing of Oracle Business
 • Intelligence (OBIEE) applications including Oracle HCM Analytics ETL, Dashboard and Reports for the IPPS-A project. 
 • Responsibility over technical solution design, development, deployment/cutover, and implementation - covering all technical aspects of the IPPS-A implementation lifecycle. 
 • Works closely with OBI team members, SMEs and Testers using Agile sessions to develop high quality user-friendly IPPS-A Dashboard and Reports
 • Good working knowledge of integration of HCM Analytics with ODI, Oracle Access manager, PeopleSoft, BI Publisher, and SharePoint
 • 3+ years enterprise level design and development experience using OBI HCM Analytics
 • Proven track record of successful implementation of all project life cycle stages from requirements gathering through implementation and enhancements.
 • Good working knowledge of extending OBI HCM Apps and related ETL programs with new data sources, DFFs, and new DWH tables
 • Strong knowledge of Oracle databases, UNIX environment, UNIX shell scripts, SQL and PL/SQL, and XML and encryption technologies
 • Experience with PeopleSoft HCM 9.x
 • Possess prior experience of supporting large scale organizations with successful ERP implementation(s).
